title: Vein Miner
description: Mine entire ore veins with a single block break! Save time and gather resources instantly.
body:
## Dependencies
* Fabric API

## About Vein Miner

Tired of spending your time mining ore blocks one by one? **Vein Miner** is a simple, lightweight Quality of Life mod designed to save you time and make resource gathering much more efficient. 

When you break a block, this mod automatically detects and breaks all connected blocks of the same type. This means you can harvest an entire ore vein instantly with just a single block break!

## Why Download This Mod?

If you want to skip the tedious grind of clearing out large ore clusters and get straight back to building, crafting, or exploring, this mod is for you. It speeds up your mining trips significantly, providing a smoother survival experience.

## How It Works & Controls

The mod is active by default and works automatically when you mine. However, there are times when you might want to be precise and leave some blocks behind. 

* **Hold `Left Shift` (Sneak / Crouch):** Temporarily disables the vein mining effect. If you break a block while sneaking, only that single block will be mined, leaving the rest of the vein completely untouched.
